newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Belgian provinces enter Maastricht airport fray.
newsitem.headline: Belgian provinces enter Maastricht airport fray.

text.p: Three Belgian provincial authorities have criticised the Dutch cabinet's decision to approve a limited expansion of Maastricht Aachen airport, a Netherlands Ministry of Transport spokesman said.

The spokesman told Reuters in a telephone interview the municipalities of Lanaken, Riemst and Bilzen which are located close to Maastricht, have complained about the plan to allow charter night flights and to build a new runway at the southern Dutch airport.

The local councils have, he said, requested talks on the expansion with the Belgian transport minister Michel Daerden. They are to ask the Belgian government to investigate the airport's growth plans, and are concerned about excessive noise.

There is growing disquiet about the expansion plan in the Netherlands as well. The Council of Beek, in whose juresdiction the airport lies said the decision, taken this month to allow 950 night flights a year is inadequeate to secure local jobs. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
